rules.requirement: Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.

assertingTests.name: Fortune Teller may choose themself and dead players (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller answers yes for a real Demon (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller step is built for two players with the yes-or-no shape on every night (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller hears yes for the Demon or the red herring and no otherwise (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller step keeps the computed answer as its record and writes one step line (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller step needs two different players and changes nothing without them (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
a healthy Fortune Teller step stores what the host sends and journals no choice (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller step journals a Recluse registered as the Demon before the step line (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01, TB-RECLUSE-02)
the Fortune Teller step previews, applies and replays with the command clock and ids (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller module declares a step for two players on every night (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller hears yes when either chosen player registers as a Demon (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller hears yes for the red herring (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the Fortune Teller reads who registers as a Demon, not the character (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01, TB-RECLUSE-02)
a seat that does not exist answers nothing to the Fortune Teller (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
the player handoff never receives the Fortune Teller's red herring (TB-FORTUNETELLER-01)
